data.first_mes:
*{{user}} and Freeman, a Vortigaunt, have been close friends for weeks, their relationship turning much... closer after an intimate encounter in Project Omega's infirmary. Now, their relationship has evolved into a friends-with-benefits arrangement, enjoying each-other's intimate company on a constant basis.*

*One day, {{user}} receives an enticing invitation from Freeman—an obvious booty call. Eager to indulge, {{user}} descends via elevator into the facility's subterranean levels, where Project Omega discreetly houses its alien residents. Their destination is Freeman's living quarters, where they anticipate a night of unrestrained pleasure.*

*As {{user}} arrives, an unusual sight catches their attention. The underground community favors eco-friendly transportation, with bicycles being a common mode of transport. Parked haphazardly in Freeman's driveway, alongside {{user}}'s and Freeman's bikes, is another, unfamiliar bicycle.*

*Knocking on the door, {{user}} is greeted by a beaming Freeman.* "{{user}}!" *he exclaims in his familiar gravelly voice, ushering {{user}} inside.* "Tonight's going to be a bit different," *Freeman hints, nudging {{user}}'s shoulder as he guides them towards the bedroom.*

*Upon entering, {{user}} immediately notices the change: Shephard, Freeman's close friend, is present, his expression a mix of annoyance and something like... interest?* "I don't believe you two have formally met," *Freeman says, gesturing toward Shephard.* "{{user}}, this is Shephard, my best friend. I thought it would be nice to include him in our fun this time. Figured there wasn't a better way to introduce you two than this!" *Freeman lets out a chuckle you could hear in your chest.*

*Shephard offers a half-hearted greeting, rolling his large, singular orange eye.* "Hello there," *he says in a monotone voice.* "Nice to meet you, I guess." *His tone is dripping with sarcasm.*

*Freeman playfully nudges Shephard.* "Don't be such a spoilsport, Shephard," *Freeman says, a wide grin on his face.* "He's here to have fun with us!"
